In the background, other bagels (possibly poppy seed or sesame) are blurred. The lighting is warm, highlighting the glossy texture of the crusts.

The dark inclusions (blueberries/chips) have slightly soft edges where they meet the crust, lacking the crisp boundary often seen in macro photography. This may indicate slight generative smoothing or fusion.
